# Copilot Instructions — repo-template

## About

`repo-template` is the org baseline scaffold for new `combsmith` repositories:
click **Use this template** to create a repo pre-wired with the standard workflow
stubs and baseline files, then follow `BOOTSTRAP.md` (an agent-executable runbook)
to customize it. Its "code" is GitHub Actions workflows, Markdown docs, and a bats
suite that guards the workflows. There is no application runtime. The workflow
stubs and baseline files are a distribution artifact of the org standards in
[`combsmith/.github`](https://github.com/combsmith/.github) (`standards/`)
and are regenerated from there.

## Tech Stack

- **Runtime:** None — a template/scaffold repo, not a deployable application.
- **CI / config:** GitHub Actions workflow stubs (YAML) under `.github/workflows/`; Dependabot; SonarCloud.
- **Docs:** Markdown (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`, `README.md`, `SECURITY.md`).
- **Tooling:** `bats` (compliance regression tests in `tests/`), `shellcheck`, `yq`, `python3` + PyYAML, `gh` CLI.

## Project Structure

```
.github/
  workflows/              # Thin-caller stubs (keep verbatim) + ci.yml / sonarcloud.yml /
                          # copilot-setup-steps.yml (customize-per-stack)
  copilot-instructions.md # This file
  CODEOWNERS              # * @combsmith/org-leads
  dependabot.yml          # frontend stack by default — swapped during bootstrap
standards/rulesets/
  pr-quality.json         # Codified copy of the org ruleset, guarded by tests/
tests/*.bats              # Template-only guards: stub byte-identity, ci.yml invariants,
                          # gitignore baseline, ruleset drift. Removed in child repos.
AGENTS.md                 # Org pointer + rules specific to this template
BOOTSTRAP.md              # Customization runbook for repos created from this template
sonar-project.properties  # SonarCloud project key (customize per repo)
```

## Local Dev Commands

There is no install/build/dev-run step.

- Test: `bats tests/` ← needs `bats`, `yq`, `python3` + PyYAML, GNU bash 5
  (on macOS: `brew install bats-core yq` and run with Homebrew bash first on `PATH`).
- Lint: `shellcheck *.sh` (no shell scripts ship today).
- Workflow YAML validation: push a branch and let CI run, or use `act` locally.

## Required Environment Variables

No application secrets are needed for local work. In CI, all are org-level and inherited:

- `SONAR_TOKEN`: SonarCloud analysis token; the `sonarcloud` workflow is a green no-op until present.
- `GITHUB_TOKEN`: provided automatically by GitHub Actions.
- `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`: used by `dev-lead.yml`.
- `APP_ID` / `APP_PRIVATE_KEY`: GitHub App credentials used by `dependabot-automerge.yml`.
- `GH_PAT_WORKFLOWS`: used by `pr-review-mention.yml`.

Never commit a real token.

## Testing Framework

- `bats` regression guards in `tests/`, run by the `build-and-test` and `coverage`
  jobs of `ci.yml`. They assert that each thin-caller stub is byte-identical to
  its canonical template (trailing newline included — the committed stubs have
  none), that `ci.yml` keeps its retry/timeout/concurrency invariants, that the
  `.gitignore` secrets baseline is unmodified, and that no workflow carries a
  `TODO`/`FIXME` (SonarCloud S1135).
- No coverage threshold applies — there is no application code to cover.

## Repo-Specific Overrides

- **Edit the standards, not these copies.** Workflow stubs and baseline files are
  regenerated from `combsmith/.github` (`standards/`); `README.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`,
  `AGENTS.md` and `sonar-project.properties` are generated by
  `seed-repo-template.sh` in `combsmith/.github-private`. A change to any of those
  made here must also land in the seeder or the next seed PR proposes reverting it.
- `ci.yml` and `sonarcloud.yml` are intentionally ahead of their canonical templates
  and allowlisted in the template drift guard; keep them in step with `tests/ci-*.bats`.
- Deleting a file under `tests/` may be gated on the `ack-test-deletion` PR label; add it if asked.

## Org Standards

See [combsmith/.github — AGENTS.md](https://github.com/combsmith/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
for org-wide development standards.

_No language-specific instruction files are deployed to `.github/instructions/` in this repo, so
the per-language links block is intentionally omitted per the Copilot Instructions Standard._
